  printf '%s archive_sha256=' "$f"; tar -xOf tapes/friday.tar "$f" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'

  printf '%s live_mode=' "$f"; stat -c '%a' "live/$f"

printf 'customers_sha256='; sha256sum live/customers.csv | awk '{print $1}'

[ ! -e live/old-notes.txt ]
